result.question: What did Athaliah see before she tore her clothes?

readings.answer: the king standing by the pillar
readings.support: saw the king standing by the pillar

readings.answer: the officers and trumpeters beside the king
readings.support: The officers and trumpeters were beside the king

readings.answer: all the people of the land rejoicing and blowing trumpets
readings.support: all the people of the land were rejoicing and blowing trumpets

assessments.reason: The text explicitly says she “saw the king standing by the pillar,” which directly matches the key.
The verse describes, before she tore her clothes, that “The officers and trumpeters were beside the king,” which she would naturally see when she looked out at the scene.
It also states, prior to her tearing her clothes, that “all the people of the land were rejoicing and blowing trumpets,” which she would reasonably see as part of the scene she looked out upon.

result.reason: The passage presents several things visible before Athaliah tore her clothes (the king, the officers/trumpeters, and the rejoicing people), so more than one materially different answer fits.
